actions.mechanism: Read-time deadline checks prevent expired records being labeled fresh, even when background cleanup runs late.
actions.implementation: Stamp each fetch with monotonic start time; expire by start plus 300 seconds, or earlier source expiry. Delete expired entries before serving.
actions.check: With a fake clock, reads immediately before expiry succeed; reads at or after expiry miss, including during outages.
actions.risk: Starting freshness at fetch initiation shortens useful cache lifetime.

actions.action: Make timeout and outage responses explicit.
actions.mechanism: A bounded source request produces a documented unavailable response rather than an expired record or indefinite wait.
actions.implementation: Set a configurable source deadline. On timeout, cancel the fetch and return 503 with source_timeout. Delete expired entries; retain unexpired entries until their deadlines.
actions.check: Simulate a hanging source: misses return 503 within the configured deadline and scheduling tolerance; expired records are never returned.
actions.risk: An overly short deadline rejects recoverable slow requests.

actions.mechanism: Atomic admission keeps the cache within 100 records while preserving useful entries during source failures.
actions.implementation: Under one lock, remove expired entries, then evict the least recently used entry only when admitting a successful new record into a full cache.
actions.check: Insert 101 distinct records and verify the expected eviction. Concurrent insertions never exceed 100 entries; failed fetches never evict unexpired entries.
actions.risk: Large individual records still require a separate byte limit.

actions.action: Coalesce duplicate fetches and bound pending work.
actions.mechanism: One source fetch per key prevents duplicate requests; bounded admission prevents outage-driven accumulation of pending work.
actions.implementation: Maintain a bounded map of in-flight promises. Join existing fetches; reject excess distinct-key fetches with 503 busy. Remove promises on every completion path.
actions.check: Send simultaneous misses for one key: observe one source call. Hang distinct-key requests and verify the configured pending-work limit holds.
actions.risk: Waiters need independent cancellation without canceling their shared fetch.

actions.action: Reject nonpublic data before cache admission.
actions.mechanism: An explicit public-data boundary prevents credentials, private fields, and personalized responses from entering the cache or diagnostics.
actions.implementation: Fetch only approved public endpoints without user credentials. Validate a public-field allowlist, reject unexpected fields, and disable request-body and response-body logging.
actions.check: Inject an unexpected sensitive field and a credential-bearing request; verify rejection and absence from cache, logs, and error responses.
actions.risk: Field validation alone cannot establish that a source is public.

actions.action: Pause source calls after repeated failures.
actions.mechanism: A circuit breaker makes sustained outages explicit while preserving access to records that remain unexpired.
actions.implementation: After a configured failure threshold, open the circuit for a bounded cooldown. Serve valid hits; return 503 source_unavailable for misses. Permit one recovery probe.
actions.check: Force threshold failures, confirm no source calls during cooldown, then recover the source and verify one successful probe restores fetching.
actions.risk: Cooldown delays recovery detection; expiry and eviction rules must remain unchanged.

actions.action: Prevent late fetches from resurrecting records.
actions.mechanism: Fetch-generation checks block obsolete or canceled completions from overwriting newer data or recreating entries after invalidation.
actions.implementation: Give each admitted fetch a generation token. Commit only if its token remains current, its request remains active, and its original expiry deadline has not passed.
actions.check: Complete a canceled fetch after a newer successful fetch; verify no overwrite. Complete another after its deadline; verify no cache insertion.
actions.risk: Generation bookkeeping must be bounded and removed when no longer needed.
